units.source_en: That fool Nobuyasu—why did he not know enough to save his own life!
units.source_zh: 信康这个傻货，怎不知救自己一命！

paragraphs.source_zh: “信康还是老样子吗？”家康不断派人去二俣城，询问信康的情况。二俣城地处敌我双方领地交界之处，如果从那里逃出，藏进山区的话，德川方面就鞭长莫及了。信康这个傻货，怎不知救自己一命！

paragraphs.source_en: As Ieyasu waited in burning impatience for a miracle, the month slipped unnoticed into its final days. On the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month, temporary quarters for Lady Tsukiyama were completed in the northwestern corner of Hamamatsu.

units.source_en: As Ieyasu waited in burning impatience for a miracle, the month slipped unnoticed into its final days.
units.source_zh: 家康心急如焚地等待着奇迹的发生，不觉已到了八月下旬。

units.source_en: On the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month, temporary quarters for Lady Tsukiyama were completed in the northwestern corner of Hamamatsu.
units.source_zh: 八月二十四，筑山夫人的临时住所在滨松的西北角建起来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康心急如焚地等待着奇迹的发生，不觉已到了八月下旬。八月二十四，筑山夫人的临时住所在滨松的西北角建起来了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lady Tsukiyama has lost her reason. She has gone mad.”

units.source_en: “Lady Tsukiyama has lost her reason. She has gone mad.”
units.source_zh: “筑山夫人神志错乱，已经疯了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “筑山夫人神志错乱，已经疯了。”

paragraphs.source_en: On hearing this, Ieyasu thought that it would be enough if only her life could be spared.

units.source_en: On hearing this, Ieyasu thought that it would be enough if only her life could be spared.

ja.t: つことができれば、それでよいと

units.source_zh: 听到这样的话，家康心里想，只要能保全她的性命就不错了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到这样的话，家康心里想，只要能保全她的性命就不错了。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu shed so many tears even in his dreams, while Lady Saigō silently wiped them away at his side.

units.source_en: Ieyasu shed so many tears even in his dreams, while Lady Saigō silently wiped them away at his side.
units.source_zh: 家康梦中都流了那么多的眼泪，西乡局在一边默默地为他擦拭泪水。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康梦中都流了那么多的眼泪，西乡局在一边默默地为他擦拭泪水。
